topic: Asking for a Rental Car Upgrade

script.title: THE FREE UPGRADE
script.scene_zh: 租車門市 · 櫃檯取車
script.story_hook: A sold-out economy lot leads to a free upgrade.
script.intro_zh: 經濟車款訂完，櫃檯卻帶來一個意想不到的好消息。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the desk! Today, renting and upgrading a car.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到櫃檯！今天來學租車與請求免費升級。
script.outro: A bigger car, a fair price, an honest photo. Drive happy!
script.outro_zh: 更大的車、合理的價格、坦率的拍照紀錄。用車愉快！
script.practice_intro_en: Time to speak along. Copy every line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 輪到我們開口了，逐句模仿跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a tanned woman in her thirties with wavy shoulder-length blonde hair, sunglasses pushed on top of her head, a coral windbreaker over a striped tee, canvas sneakers, and an athletic build
script.char_b_description: a young man in his twenties with neat black hair and a friendly grin, a gray rental desk blazer with a logo patch over a white shirt, a name tag, dark trousers, and a lean build
script.char_a_role: customer picking up a rental car

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, reservation under Dana Whitfield.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，訂單名字是Dana Whitfield。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me pull that up… one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi pʊl ðæt ʌp wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 我調出訂單看看…請稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, it was for two days.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我們租兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it! Economy car, two days.
dialogue.zh: 找到啦！經濟型車，兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's us—well, me and my brother.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ʌs wɛl mi ænd maɪ ˈbɹʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 就是我們—呃，我和我哥兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice trip? Or work?
dialogue.zh: 是出遊還是辦事呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beach wedding for my cousin.
dialogue.zh: 海邊婚禮，我表弟要結婚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fun! Okay, small hiccup for you.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來好玩！不過，先說個小狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hiccup? I don't like that word.
dialogue.zh: 小狀況？我不太喜歡這個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our economy cars are all gone today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɹ ɪˈkɑnəmi kɑɹz ɑɹ ɔl ɡɔn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天經濟型全都借出去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gone? But I booked in March!
dialogue.zh: 借光了？可我三月就訂好了呀！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, so here's the good part.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈnoʊ soʊ hɪɹz ðə ɡʊd pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，所以重點在後半句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The good part? This sounds scary.
dialogue.zh: 重點在後半句？聽起來怪嚇人的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get a midsize at no extra cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛt ə ˈmɪdˌsaɪz ʔæt noʊ ˈɛkstɹə kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 你可以免費升級到中大型車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, free upgrade? Say that again.
dialogue.zh: 等等，免費升級？請你再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A midsize, free, today only.
dialogue.zh: 中大型車，不加價，只限今天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay! What does it look like?
dialogue.zh: 好！那輛車長什麼樣子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A gray sedan, clean and quiet.
dialogue.zh: 灰色四門轎車，乾淨又安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take it. Where do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ɪt wɛɹ du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我要它。請問要在哪裡簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost—first, second driver?
dialogue.zh: 快了—先問問，要有第二位駕駛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My brother can drive. What's the fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbɹʌðɚ kən dɹaɪv wæts ðə fi/
dialogue.zh: 我哥也能開。要多收多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually ten dollars per day.
dialogue.zh: 通常一天收十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten a day? So two days, twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ə deɪ soʊ tu deɪz ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 一天十塊？那兩天就是二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep. He does half the driving, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp hi dʌz hæf ðə ˈdɹaɪvɪŋ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是呀。一半的路都讓他開，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half? My brother drives everything.
dialogue.zh: 一半？我哥開車什麼都想包辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it's a deal worth having.
dialogue.zh: 那這錢花得絕對值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point. Add him. What does he need?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ pɔɪnt æd hɪm wʌt dʌz hi nid/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，加他吧。他需要準備什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His license and his presence.
dialogue.zh: 他的駕照，還有他本人到場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, insurance. My card covers rentals.
dialogue.zh: 再來是保險，我的信用卡附租車保障。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which card? The blue one?
dialogue.zh: 哪一張卡？藍色那張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the travel rewards one.
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那個旅行積分卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news, that one does count.
dialogue.zh: 好消息，那張的保障有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Last year it didn't cover us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli læst jɪɹ ɪt ˈdɪdənt ˈkʌvəɹ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？去年它還不算數呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rules changed this spring, so lucky you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹuːlz tʃeɪndʒd ðɪs spɹɪŋ soʊ ˈlʌki ju/
dialogue.zh: 今年春天改了新規，所以你運氣好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky indeed. What about damage?
dialogue.zh: 確實運氣好。那車損怎麼算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're covered up to three thousand.
dialogue.zh: 三千美元以內的損失都保。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And below that, I pay?
dialogue.zh: 起賠額以下就由我自理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the first fee, that's all.
dialogue.zh: 只扣一個基本自負額，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, okay. One more nervous question.
dialogue.zh: 好，好。還有一個讓我緊張的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask away, I like questions.
dialogue.zh: 請說，我喜歡有人問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the car… washed? Last time, mud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə kɑɹ wɔʃt læst taɪm mʌd/
dialogue.zh: 車洗過了嗎？上回我們滿車泥巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it comes out shiny today.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，今天剛洗過，亮晶晶的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beautiful. Keys? When do we roll?
dialogue.zh: 完美。鑰匙呢？我們幾點能出發？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys next. Return is Friday noon.
dialogue.zh: 下一步給鑰匙。週五中午還車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday noon. Full tank or empty?
dialogue.zh: 週五中午。油要加滿還是用空？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full to full, same as always.
dialogue.zh: 滿油借滿油還，和平常一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a gas place by your lot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ɡæs pleɪs baɪ jɔɹ lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 你們停車場附近有加油站嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a cheap one, two blocks north.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə tʃip wʌn tu blɑks nɔɹθ/
dialogue.zh: 有，往北兩個街口，那家很便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know… wait, what's that scratch?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ weɪt wæts ðæt skɹætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 知道了…等等，那道刮痕是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where? Oh, on the rear bumper.
dialogue.zh: 哪裡？喔，是後保桿上那道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we pretend I didn't see it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi pɹɪˈtɛnd aɪ ˈdɪdənt si ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們要不要假裝我沒看見？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, I'll photograph it right now.
dialogue.zh: 不用假裝，我現在就拍照記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I keep the photo too?
dialogue.zh: 那照片也會給我一份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, email's coming your way.
dialogue.zh: 當然，馬上寄到你的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, you're thorough. I like that.
dialogue.zh: 哇，你做事真周到，我很欣賞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps everyone's return day calm.
dialogue.zh: 這樣還車那天大家都安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All done? My brother looks happy.
dialogue.zh: 都辦好了嗎？我哥看起來開心極了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One signature, then off you go.
dialogue.zh: 再簽一個名，你們就出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed! Beach wedding, here we come.
dialogue.zh: 簽好！海邊婚禮，我們來啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe and enjoy that free upgrade!
dialogue.phonetic: /dɹaɪv seɪf ænd ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðæt fri ˈʌpˌɡreɪd/
dialogue.zh: 開車小心，好好享受這趟免費升級！

預約的經濟型車竟然全訂光了，怎麼辦？這段60句美式英文聽力，記錄一次因緣際會的免費升級🚙

婚禮用車之旅在租車櫃檯遇上小狀況：經濟車全出借。櫃員提出免費升等中大型車，兩人接著談第二位駕駛的費用、信用卡租車險的新規、滿油借滿油還的規矩，還有一道後保桿刮痕的處理方式。

- 留證據：I'll photograph it right now.

Your economy car is sold out—now what? This 60-line American English listening scene captures one lucky free upgrade at the rental desk 🚙

A wedding trip almost starts badly when the small cars are gone. The agent offers a free midsize upgrade, then the two talk through an extra driver fee, credit card rental insurance, full-to-full fuel rules, and a rear bumper scratch documented on the spot. Every line is a phrase you will actually hear at a counter.

You will hear:
- The hiccup: Our economy cars are all gone today.
- The offer: You get a midsize at no extra cost.
- Insurance talk: Really? Last year it didn't cover us.
- Honest proof: I'll photograph it right now.

The second half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing 🎧, sentences under 10 words with connected-speech IPA, ideal for A2 learners.
